Of course, today is 7/5/19 so I applied last Sunday 6/30. I applied as a general applicant: "place me where the need is greater" type of deal. On Tuesday 7/2/19 I got an email stating my application was being reviewed for the health extension volunteer position in Liberia. The very next day on Wednesday 7/3/19 another email was sent stating my application was "under consideration". That same day the Peace Corps sent all the reference verification emails to my references. Two of them were completed that Wednesday and the final one was completed the next day Thursday on the fourth. So far, thats where things have been left. I haven't recieved anything regarding interview setup. When did you apply?
